source_bound_sequence: The original criterion and manifest are byte-identical; the pre-run static-source mapping defect is recorded in its erratum. Commit this corrected criterion and target declaration before generating or inspecting any target candidate, search trace, receipt or held-out outcome.
Extend only the existing #116 CEGIS lane for three-input arithmetic and a selected manifest, with non-held-out regression tests; commit the generator and test runner before generating targets.

Run #116 once from a clean commit with this frozen target manifest, retaining its unmodified receipt, generated candidate bodies, grammar, budget, search/refutation trace, solver verdict, held-out producer observations and CLI re-admission status.

Commit that producer receipt without changing this criterion or target manifest. Run the four-arm transfer exactly once from a later clean commit with output outside the tree. Retain raw output and source-bound receipt, including failures; do not rerun or choose a replacement target after seeing outcomes.
control_pool_and_selection: Use the predecessor's lexically selected size-matched non-transfer control over arithScaled, arithProduct and bitXor before looking at outcomes. Require <=10% canonical-byte size difference or report control unavailable; never silently substitute another control.
negative_control: After all four scored arms at each seed, use a separate fresh library to deliberately request both RuntimeProducer::Proposer and RuntimeProducer::Teacher with counting callbacks. Each request must refuse Unsupported before callback execution; record one attempt of each kind, zero actual callbacks, unchanged identity manifest and zero new records. A failed refusal or a host callback is a NO-GO. The probe is inside the same one-shot source-bound run, but outside scored arms: attempted calls do not contaminate transfer-arm metrics.
go_rule: GO iff both declared targets have #116-generated candidates with normal CLI readmission and passing producer held-out examples, both solver verdicts and all witness/counterexample traces are retained without upgrading an unproven status to a proof, the accumulated learned arm passes all 8 seed-task cells and 24/24 cases, all scored arms record zero proposer and teacher calls and attempts, every per-seed negative control refuses both attempts with zero host callbacks, and all restart/regression checks pass. Otherwise NO-GO; retain every failure.
report: per seed and arm: acquisition count, generations, canonical bytes, identity and restart match, retrieval queries/examined/monotonic ns, composed task and example outcomes, regression counts, proposer/teacher attempts and calls, break-even or null reason
producer task status, candidate, search/solver witness trace, held-out agreement, tool identities, manifest and source digests
model/synthesis behavior, executed mechanics, Rust-Lean correspondence and assumptions as distinct claims
non_claims: Producer references and examples are declared inputs; #116 generates the candidate programs and checks them, not the reference expressions themselves.
A solver UNSAT or passing fixture is not an independently kernel-checked universal proof.
The second held-out run cannot retroactively change the predecessor's frozen criterion or receipt.
No universal transfer, lifelong learning, speedup, semantic alias or Rust byte-encoder refinement is inferred from this finite experiment.
